text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I absolutely have to do a good job at
the enka
contest...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all started when Sakura Chiyono O
and I were on our way back to the
academy after spending
the day out and
about...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O! Can you please participate
in an
Umamusume enka contest we're
holding?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's an event for the elderly... One
of the
participants got injured and can't
make it
anymore, so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Chiyono, you're always humming
enka songs with gliding note changes
and stuff, so you
must be good! Please,
you've gotta do this!
choice_data_list: Let's just say we happened to be p...
So we just happened to be passing ...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
O-oh gosh! I'm flattered, but I couldn't
possibly! I only dabble a little in enka,
so I'm nowhere near
good enough.
Although...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I suppose the saying does go that "every
race starts with the first furlong." In
other words, that
first step is the most
important... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Sakura Chiyono O signs up as a

participant in the enka contest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! ♪
My looove is swallowed by the
wiiind ♪
And vanishes in the dark
waaaves! ♪

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was wonderful, Kita! My heart is
still
racing from your performance!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Your vocal runs and vibrato were
wonderful... Oh,
I've grown soft with
age... I'm starting to tear up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Urgh... I'm so scared about going on
stage... B-but I have to muster up the
courage for the
sake of performing with
Opera O!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! ♪
The snooow wraps youuu ♪
In
its embraaace! ♪

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Very good, Doto! That delicate voice of
yours is
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Everyone's amazing... Their
singing is so
captivating... But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm next... Wh-what am I going to do?
My hands
are shaking!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now for someone who impresses
even Kitasan
Black! It's Sakura Chiyono
O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I-I have to sing my best... Uh... Uh...
How do
enka songs go again?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is shaking, but I can
tell there's
nothing to worry about. I
know just how
courageous she really is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Right... I don't have time to flounder
around like
this... I just need to open my
mouth... and sing the
first verse!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-as the clouds scatter...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaaah! ♪
Your love is reveaaaled ♪
In
the shadow of the mooon! ♪

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Wow! What feeling!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Such emotion! I can tell just
from her
singing just how genuine her
feelings are!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! ♪
Dearest cherry blossoms of the
niiight! ♪
Tell me nooow, do you feel my
looove? ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... I actually managed to do it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O! That was so moving! All of your feelings came across like bam! Hit me right in the heart!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-that really warmed my heart too!
Your singing
is so comforting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What? Me? But I'm nowhere near as
good as
either of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you, everyone! My face is
getting red...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Trainer... You're the
reason I was
able to sing so well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was panicking and didn't know what to
do... But
when I heard your voice, I
realized...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm by myself onstage, I'm not
alone.
There are people out there
watching me and
supporting me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to pour all my
feelings of
appreciation into my song!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Great! Hehe... It'd be nice to participate
in
another Umamusume enka contest
sometime.
choice_data_list: Your feelings came through loud an...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We can ask for an encore? Encore!
Encore!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-o-oh dear... Are they sure? I mean...
what if I
mess up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! Just remember, every race
starts
with the first furlong! Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Great! We'll start with the first furlong,
then! Let's
combine our strength and
give 'em a great
encore! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
Woo! ♪
W-woo! ♪
